runtime_scenarios.name: pilot_fit_time_with_ideal_two_worker_utilization
runtime_scenarios.assumption: Same average per-fit cost as nine flow pilot jobs, perfect two-worker utilization, no overhead. Not a lower bound.

runtime_scenarios.name: original_pilot_after_subtracting_recorded_loading
runtime_scenarios.assumption: Same mixed-fold fit/checkpoint pace as original pilot; not a measured optimized full-run pace.

runtime_scenarios.name: latest_fold_thread_benchmark_pace
runtime_scenarios.assumption: Apply latest-fold three-case pace to every fit; includes dispatch, excludes uploads. Not an upper bound.

runtime_limits: Illustrative extrapolations, not confidence intervals or guaranteed bounds.
Only three flow features and three horizons measured; other families may cost more or less.
Ineligible training folds use recorded fallback and can reduce fit count.
Remaining source-cache loading, restarts, hardware variation and validation add time.
Four-hour sessions are a proposed soft work budget, not a promise about Colab availability.

execution_plan.compute: Two persistent thread workers; one native thread per worker. Keep process alternative unpromoted.
execution_plan.io: At most two remote-read workers initially; one dedicated ordered Drive writer with bounded queue.
execution_plan.order: Flow first to reuse cache, then remaining families in frozen alphabetical order; features/horizons in frozen order. No score-based ordering.
execution_plan.first_authorized_batch: At most four previously uncompleted feature-horizon jobs, all five folds and six inner settings. Retain them as part of full screen, not disposable tests.
execution_plan.session_budget: Four-hour soft deadline from session start including loading. Stop admitting work near deadline; finish active fits, flush and verify writes, then exit cleanly.
execution_plan.resume: User reruns Colab notebook. Validate source identities/config/software/receipt hashes, reload completed monthly caches, skip verified saved fits, recover missing aggregates from fold receipts.
execution_plan.checkpoint: Save compact fit scores and coverage after each fit; serialize immutable snapshots in one writer. Mark jobs complete only after durable verified upload. Unsaved active fits may restart.
execution_plan.storage: Reuse current compact monthly-checkpointed family/horizon caches. No local datasets, losing model binaries or row-level predictions.
execution_plan.progress: Stage messages, per-fit completion, regular elapsed/queue/remaining-work status. Treat timeouts as interruption, never as feature ineligibility or score fallback.
execution_plan.matrix: One row per target/feature/transformation/horizon with model, fold-selected settings, baseline/candidate errors, improvement, coverage, fallbacks and verification limitations.

quality_requirements: Keep frozen six-setting grid, five chronological folds and deterministic inner-only selection.
Same baseline evaluation rows; train-only median imputation and missing indicator.
Keep strict label-end purging, research-origin cutoff and final-six-month exclusion.
Keep source validity/availability/baseline-count gates and provisional-data limitations.
Retain independent prediction traversal and exact saved-score equivalence checks.
Do not reduce folds, sample rows, weaken criteria, or drop difficult rows to meet a time budget.
required_before_launch: Integrate prepared-array reuse, persistent threading and ordered checkpointing into resumable full runner; current optimized modules are diagnostics only.
Verify saved remote worker/profile receipts against packaged source hashes.

Implement explicit compatibility manifest: preserve historical pilot identity and all nine job hashes; record actual reference/optimized implementation hashes separately. Never relabel old receipts or bypass mismatched identities.
Test interruption after fit upload/before aggregate, failed upload, stale snapshot ordering, identity/version rejection and zero-fit resume of completed work on synthetic data.
Package pilot-safe Colab notebook with an explicit disabled full-launch switch and session limits.
Obtain explicit authorization for the first new batch/full expansion; this plan does not authorize training.
eventual_system: Allow connected specialist models when chronological evaluation supports them; one shared model is optional.
